program: F124-F scientific architecture trial, independent of FORGE autonomy F124/F125
negative: F124-E 3-slot models 0/48 paired in Wingless and Yggdrasil versus fixed 45/48 and 39/48; causal record survival 36/48 and 32/48 (A), 34/48 and 32/48 (B). Posthoc 32-slot capacity restored 48/48 causal records while classification stayed 0/48 or 1/48. Both retention and retrieval/readout mechanisms are deficient. Do not retune any existing result.
hypothesis: At a fixed three-record memory budget, key-based priority conditioned on the next public role and outgoing source tokens, coupled to a learned signed log-evidence readout rather than unnormalized accumulated mass, will preserve and use causal history in new reconvergent graphs. Distinct-key retention should outperform a purely mass-prioritized competitor under equal information and bounded computation.

arms.A: Public raw carried-key state with trainable 16-bit compatibility vector and differentiable key-query gate; prospective next-role/outgoing-edge query selects up to 3 individual records at each node. Score from hop-normalized signed log-evidence (target vs null competing paths), learned head. No preselected oracle path, precomputed equality bit, or label attached to edges.
arms.B: Arm A plus learned diversity-aware conditional record priority, penalizing redundant near-duplicate keys (trainable scalar) at the identical 3-slot budget. All input and computational differences declared. No query role beyond provided public query sequence.
arms.common: Fixed 100 epochs; 4 distinct paired TRAIN examples cyclically sampled per epoch, balanced binary cross entropy plus 0.5 paired contrastive softplus; 0.5 sigmoid decision. Trainable <=128 parameters, 16 raw bits, exactly 3 records/node and <=128 live messages/hop. Hard top-k selection nondifferentiable and declared; gradients checked only through surviving selected records.
arms.mechanistic_tests: Public next-query priority must be ablated separately, causal record retained vs evicted, unnecessary key deletes vs true causal key deletes, key-value swap preserving token histogram, depth-only control and edge permutation.

cohorts.holdout_rule: Do not generate, inspect, or score CONFIRM without independent sealed first-use qualification; no TRAIN-based success claims of generalization.

environment.input: Unordered graph {start,target,roles,edges:[{from,to,role,src_bits[16],dst_bits[16]}]}; strict public field whitelist. IDs salted per TRAIN seed/lane/candidate, never model labels.
environment.generation: Independent new source-birth salt; two reconvergences, 3+ role-compatible paths, public parallel edges, role decoys, near-neighbor bit aliases, repeated-token wrong-route strata. Positive has exactly one slot-consistent public path, matched negative none.
environment.counterfactual: Swap necessary continuation source token and off-role decoy source token to preserve public topology, role/query, edge count and entire raw-token multiset.
environment.source_admission: Independent exact symbolic scorer checks 1/0 truth and >=3 role-only alternative routes for both paired cases, fail closed ambiguity.
environment.anti_shortcut: Topological/role/depth/token histogram-only control may not predict paired label; shuffled edge-order invariance; disjoint salt/role/node/token seeds.

controls.F124E_frozen: Original 0/48 result and original frozen weights preserved as negative; old CONFIRM closed.
controls.fixed_Hamming_12of16: Public slot-compatible heuristic (12/16) and actual bit and edge scan counts. No symbolic ceiling eligible for learned +0.05 success comparator.
controls.role_and_depth_only: Query/topology/role counts only; no raw token inputs.
controls.histogram_only: Global token multiset only; no link between token and graph edge.
controls.exact_symbolic: Independent fully public consistent slot route scorer as computational ceiling, excluded from learning advantage comparator.
controls.ablate_query_priority: Use identical weights but unconditional previous mass-only top-k as diagnostic, not permitted tuned candidate.

evaluation.primary: One-time independently witnessed 7–9-hop CONFIRM paired accuracy, balanced binary accuracy in each lane, performance vs strongest eligible same-information, equivalent-resource nonlearned comparator.
evaluation.training_development: TRAIN-only record any negatives with accurate source/provenance, no retuning on reserved examples. Two learned arms selected by TRAIN paired accuracy (tie A) only.
evaluation.threshold: At least +0.05 paired accuracy vs strongest resource-matched nonlearned comparator in BOTH lanes, no alias/collision stratum harm, nonzero learned updates, causally aligned retrieval; no promotion based on synthetic CI.
evaluation.causal: Record whether necessary key was evicted before outgoing query, causal key deletion vs distractor deletion posthoc, and depth-stratified error.
evaluation.resource: Record edge scans, per-bit arithmetic, activation/op counts, peak record slots, messages, learning parameter footprint and CPU time where available; disparate primitive budgets imply superiority NOT_ESTABLISHED.
evaluation.custody: Hash frozen protocol Git blob, implementation Git blob, exact TRAIN candidate source identity, all model/heuristic weights, source commit and CI receipts; independent original first-use separately authenticated.
